Book II

Begin the morning by saying to thyself, I shall meet with the busybody, the ungrateful, arrogant, deceitful, envious, unsocial. For we are made for cooperation, like feet, like hands.24 To act against one another then is contrary to nature.

Theophrastus, in his comparison of bad acts⁠—such a comparison as one would make⁠—says, like a true philosopher, that it’s so.
